anatomy.demo: PromiseProductProofAction

parts.desc: 一句话讲清对象、问题和结果，不把功能列表塞进标题
parts.desc_en: A concise statement of audience, problem, and outcome rather than a feature list

parts.desc: 用真实界面或流程证明产品确实能完成刚才的承诺
parts.desc_en: A real interface or workflow that demonstrates the promised result

parts.desc: 客户、数据和案例紧挨对应主张，减少空泛感
parts.desc_en: Customers, data, and cases placed beside the claims they support

parts.desc: 页面各段都能自然回到同一个清晰的下一步
parts.desc_en: A consistent next step that the page naturally returns to

use.t: SaaS、AI 工具和开发者产品官网：需要同时解释能力和推动注册
产品已有可展示界面：把真实工作流作为页面的主要视觉内容
销售路径较长：用客户证据和场景逐步降低决策风险
品牌需要持续扩展：统一卡片、数据和内容模块，便于长期迭代

dont.t: 功能卡片占据首屏：用户尚未理解产品定位，就要比较多个同级卖点
用渐变代替产品证据：视觉风格无法说明产品能力与使用方式
同时放多个主要 CTA：免费试用、购买、咨询与下载并列，会削弱下一步的优先级
复制其他 SaaS 的话术和结构：页面应以自身产品、用户与证据组织内容

principles.t: 首屏只讲一个核心承诺：说明给谁、解决什么问题，以及为什么值得继续看
尽早展示真实产品：界面截图、工作流或结果，比抽象光效更能建立理解
证据沿阅读路径出现：客户、评价、数据和案例应支持附近的主张
主行动保持一致：免费试用、预约演示或联系销售，优先选择一个主要方向

en.prompt: SaaS product marketing website, one focused value proposition, real product interface as the main visual, customer logos and specific metrics for trust, one clear primary action, soft gradient used only as atmosphere, restrained card hierarchy, calm and precise

use.t: SaaS, AI tools, and developer products that must explain capability and encourage signup
Products with a useful interface to show, where the real workflow can become the visual lead
Longer sales journeys that need evidence and scenarios to reduce perceived risk
Brands that will keep expanding and benefit from reusable product, data, and content modules

dont.t: Fill the first screen with feature cards before the visitor understands what the product is
Use gradients instead of product proof, leaving a technology mood but no concrete understanding
Present several competing primary actions for trial, purchase, contact, and download
Copy another SaaS company's structure and language; specificity builds more trust than familiarity

principles.t: Make one promise above the fold: say who the product serves, what it changes, and why the visitor should keep reading
Show the real product early: a credible interface, workflow, or outcome explains more than an abstract glow
Place proof along the story: customers, reviews, numbers, and cases should support the claim beside them
Keep one primary action: choose a trial, demo, or sales conversation as the main direction
